title: Line sketch: Cyberpunk Citadel
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A towering futuristic city rises from a dark plateau against a vibrant and gradient sky. Glowing and lights illuminate the silhouetted spires and structures in this synthwave-inspired digital landscape (derived from painting #360).
